entries.description: Verify and settle x402 gasless stablecoin payments across EVM, Solana, NEAR, Stellar, Algorand, Sui and XRPL. Streamable HTTP, stateless, no authentication and no fee: the payer's signature inside the payload is the only authority.
representativeQueries: settle an x402 payment on Base
which networks and stablecoins can this facilitator settle
verify an EIP-3009 payment authorization before charging
pay for an API that answered 402 Payment Required

entries.description: The same facilitator described as an A2A agent card: who it is, what it settles, and where to reach it.
representativeQueries: find an agent that can settle a stablecoin payment on-chain
who settles x402 payments without charging a fee

entries.description: The operating manual for calling verify and settle: request and response shapes, the exact/upto/escrow/commerce schemes, the per-chain EIP-712 domain-name trap, the rate-limit headers, and which failures mean retry rather than stop.
representativeQueries: how do I call POST /verify and POST /settle
why is my EIP-712 signature rejected on Celo but not on Base
which x402 settlement errors are worth retrying

entries.description: Every HTTP endpoint this facilitator serves, typed: verify, settle, accepts, supported, the Bazaar discovery registry, the ERC-8004 identity and reputation routes, and the live traffic stream.
representativeQueries: what endpoints does the x402 facilitator expose
read an agent's ERC-8004 reputation on Base
list the x402-priced resources in the bazaar

entries.description: The llmstxt.org index for this host: what the service is, when to reach for it and when not to, its live coverage, and a link to every other document it publishes.
representativeQueries: what is the Ultravioleta DAO x402 facilitator
when should an agent use a payment facilitator
